[spoiler=Thyven military withdrawal from Sal-Baliz][quote=the_crystalline_empire;60763137][b]December 16, 2026: Territorial Reorganisation[/b]

Since early 2025, the armed forces of Thýven had held a slice of land within the Shamatine state of Sal-Baliz, formed following the fall of the terrorist group of the same name that had operated within the center of the continent where the kingdom of Sal-Baliz now sat. The land had been renamed to Izmyr by the Thývenic military command and had been delegated to be a condominium with the kingdom under the laws of said institution. 

However, as a year had passed without issue within the territory, and with the massive restructuring of the government in the mainland, it was decided that Thýven would formally cede the territory back to the kingdom of Sal-Baliz and withdraw the 20,000 troops it had there in order to prepare for the overall reorganisation of the armed forces that was planned. 

Thus on the morning of December 16th the First Council would release a joint statement declaring that: The restoration of order and stability within the region of Izmyr has been completed under the  provisions of the joint Sal-Baliz-Thýven treaty signed in mid-2025, as such the central government of Thýven shall withdraw fully its claim and its forces from the territory of Izmyr, granting total control to the government of the kingdom of Sal-Baliz. The withdrawal shall be completed by January 20, 2027 with all forces being re-stationed in our West Shamat base to the West of the kingdom of Sal-Baliz for reorganisation and re-deployment elsewhere,

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

The Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah is pleased with Thyvens decision to withdraw all their forces from Sal-Baliz by 20 January 2027. In our view, the government there has shown itself to be capable of its own defense, and peace and order have been maintained since the end of the THEP intervention against the Islamic State there. We also view this matter, and all matters in the Shamats, to be the internal affairs of Shamatine countries. 

That being said, we call upon all Shamatine countries to increase cooperation in the economic, political, and military spheres, in order to end the conflicts in the East and prevent new ones from emerging, in shaa Allah. Any region or nation divided is far more vulnerable to external threats and imperialism. We believe that the time has come for us to establish something like the EDU or even more comprehensive for the collective improvement and defensive of the Shamats.

As an additional note, any nation threatening to take any territory by force on Shamat from any country here, or laying claim to the entirety of our region will see us go from being peaceful and benevolent to bringing the wrath of Allah down in a heartbeat. While our people love peace, they will fight tooth and nail to defend our land and our region.
